rows.note: Use this for something officially acceptable or allowed under the rules, such as a date format.

example.english: This date format is valid, so you can use it directly when filling out the form.
example.traditional: 呢個日期格式符合規定，填表嗰陣可以直接用。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jat6 kei4 gaak3 sik1 fu4 hap6 kwai1 ding6 tin4 biu2 go2 zan6 ho2 ji5 zik6 zip3 jung6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an answer, argument, or decision that is well-founded or justifiable.

example.english: Your explanation is quite valid, so we can go ahead with it.
example.traditional: 你呢個解釋幾合理，我哋可以照住做。
example.jyutping: nei5 ni1 go3 gaai2 sik1 gei2 hap6 lei5 ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 ziu3 zyu6 zou6

rows.note: Use this when the information or point is connected to the topic or context under discussion.

example.english: The point you just made is valid and relevant to what we’re discussing, so don’t change the subject.
example.traditional: 你頭先講嗰點同我哋而家傾緊嘅嘢相關，唔好扯開話題。
example.jyutping: nei5 tau4 sin1 gong2 go2 dim2 tung4 ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 king1 gan2 ge3 je5 soeng1 gwaan1 m4 hou2 ce2 hoi1 waa6 tai4
